title: Credit Ruling: Recalculation Window for a Security Deposit When Load Has Moved
content:
**Applies to:** the recalculation of a Security Deposits deposit held in full, at the member's request.

## Ruling

The recalculation window follows where the account's load now sits. When the most recent connect fee billed on the member's service accounts falls in the twelve whole months before today and was billed on another account than this one, the window is the billing periods of this account billed fewer whole months before today than have passed since that connect fee. When the most recent connect fee is not such a fee and this account itself was connected fewer than twelve whole months before today, the window is the periods billed since its connection. Otherwise this ruling sets no window.

## Records read

The connect fees are the fee charges billed as connect fees on the member's Electric Service by Rate Schedule accounts; the connect date is the one on this account's Electric Service by Rate Schedule record.

## Ladder

| What the records show | Recalculation window |
|---|---|
| the member's most recent connect fee was billed in the last twelve whole months, on another account | this account's billing periods billed fewer whole months before today than have passed since that connect fee |
| no such fee, and this account was connected fewer than twelve whole months before today | this account's billing periods since its connection |
| neither | not set by this ruling |

## Hypothetical illustrations

- The member opened a new shop meter seven whole months ago and its connect fee is the member's most recent; the window for the farm home's deposit is the farm home's billing periods billed fewer than seven whole months before today.
- The most recent connect fee was billed fourteen months ago on another account, and this account was connected eight whole months ago: the window is this account's billing periods since its connection.
- The most recent connect fee was billed on this account itself five months ago, at its connection: the first line does not apply, and the window is this account's billing periods since its connection.
